idea-plugin.name: SpringGraph
idea-plugin.description:
Checks a supported subset of Spring constructor injection with the SpringGraph annotation processor, and shows the results in the editor.

  • Gutter icons on constructor parameters of Spring components: validated (click to go to the chosen bean), runtime boundary, Spring Data repository, @Value, unsupported, missing or ambiguous (click to see the candidates).
  • SpringGraph tool window: the dependency graph per module, every finding (SG001 to SG009) with navigation to the source, excluded classes, and the share of statically validated dependencies.

Works with or without the processor in your build:

  • IDE analysis: Analyze with SpringGraph runs the processor bundled in the plugin (a pinned release of io.github.mrsluffy:springgraph-processor from Maven Central, checksum-verified, no download) over each Spring module's main sources, with the module's JDK, classpath and annotation processors (Lombok, MapStruct). Mode and runtime boundaries are set under Settings | Tools | SpringGraph. Your Gradle or Maven build is never changed.
  • Build reports: if your build already runs the processor with -Aspringgraph.mode, the plugin shows what that build reported, including a failed strict build, and refreshes after each build.

Experimental. Icons show the last analysis or build: they are hidden for a constructor whose parameter count or types changed since then, and other edits show the old result until the next run.
